patch_description: The previous edit added a shared-parameter RX layer duplicating the RY parameters before entanglement, which increased depth/gate count and slightly hurt validation/test accuracy (0.62 vs 0.63 baseline) without adding parameters. This edit reverts that costly change (removing the 9 extra RX gates) and instead inserts a single, cheap mid-circuit RX "refresh" gate on the hub qubit 0 right after the CRZ entangling block. This targets the qubit with the highest connectivity (crz_0, crz_1, crz_2 all originate from wire 0) with a fresh local rotation to help re-align amplitude before the final RZ readout layer, adding only 1 gate and 1 parameter instead of 9 gates with 0 new parameters. This should restore the previous best performance while testing whether a lightweight, localized injection can further improve gradient flow at the entanglement hub without the depth/gate-count penalty of the full shared RX layer.
